title: SLA-aware prefix sharder and replay-tolerant ingress buffer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We see tail latency spikes in the console metrics ingest pipeline when large multitenant bursts cause uneven shard hotness and frequent replays. This ticket implements an SLA-aware prefix-based sharder combined with a small in-memory replay-tolerant ingress buffer. Goals: 1) reduce hotkey amplification by routing metric prefixes with adaptive weights based on recent latencies; 2) absorb short-term replay storms with idempotent buffering and de-duplication; 3) surface per-tenant SLO violations to the console. The component will live in the ingress tier and emit telemetry for decision-making (latency histogram, 95th/99th, requeue rate).
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end ingest latency P99 reduced by >=30% for top-100 tenants during synthetic burst tests
No consumer-visible duplicate events after 2x replay flood in staging (observability shows dedupe rate >=99.9%)
Automatic shard weight adjustments kick in within 10s of SLO breach and reduce local queue depth by >=40%
Documentation and runbook added to Confluence; design reviewed and signed off by SRE and product
technical_notes: Sharder: compute prefix hash over stable prefix (namespace + metric_type) and select target using weighted consistent hashing; weights derived from exponentially-weighted moving average of observed consumer latency and queue depth
Ingress buffer: bounded lock-free ring buffer per-shard with idempotency map (LSM-backed for large windows) and sticky eviction policy for high-throughput tenants

Replay safety: use monotonic sequence IDs and short-term tombstones (TTL=5m) so that transient replays are deduped without long-lived state; tombstone store backed by RocksDB local cache with periodic compaction
Backpressure: signal upstream via HTTP 429+Retry-After and emit telemetry; fallback to best-effort sampling when persistent overload detected
Metrics emitted: shard_id, tenant_id, prefix, enqueue_latency_ms, dequeue_latency_ms, dedupe_rate, replay_count, weight_adjustments
Performance targets: steady-state per-shard throughput 20k events/s, tail latency P99 < 150ms for queueing stage under normal load
rollout_plan: Feature flag gated rollout: start off in read-only observation mode for 48h in staging
Canary in prod: enable write-path for 5% of tenants selected by risk tier for 24h
Progressive ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days if no SLO regressions
Automatic rollback configured on >3x baseline P99 increase or dedupe_rate <99%
